svg.title: Issue 1 — Page 3 — Panel 5: Sable upright, anchor amid collapse
svg.desc: Medium wide 24mm low angle from floor level — perspective of someone knocked down. Bridge in catastrophic failure: ceiling panels buckling, sparking conduits hanging loose. Sable stands fully upright (only person standing), braced against command console, iron command — compositional anchor of the image. Around her on floor: Wren on knees at sparking engineering console, still working; Luma crawling toward bulkhead medical kit; Jink tangled in jump seat harness straps. Red emergency dominant — blue-white nearly gone, only flickering dying holographic fragments. Bridge dark, lit almost entirely in harsh red. SABLE: "Wren — can we hold the corridor?" / WREN: "We're past holding. The corridor's collapsing. We need to punch through to the exit point NOW."

g.text: Wren — can we hold the corridor?
through to the exit point NOW.
